First release of wing, a small Confluent Schema Registry CLI for JSON Schema that works alongside [kite](https://github.com/addisonhuddy/kite).

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addisonhuddy/wing/main/install.sh | sh
```

- `wing push` lints a schema, runs fixture tests, checks compatibility and registers it. `--check` works offline.
- `wing write` validates JSONL records and adds the Confluent GUID schema header. `--fit` coerces records to the schema's types, fills defaults and drops extra properties.
- `wing read` resolves the GUID header or the legacy `0x00`+ID prefix and validates each record. `--check` outputs only failing records.
- `wing ls`, `wing get`, `wing rm`, `wing registry`, `wing update`.
- Validator: JSON Schema drafts 04 through 2020-12, all required cases in the official test suite pass.

Requires kite v0.4.0 or later for Kafka pipelines.
